description: This file defines API routes related to order management in an e-commerce backend. It includes endpoints to list orders, retrieve a specific order, and update order status, utilizing FastAPI and SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: get_order(order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order by its ID for the current user, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: update_order_status( order_id: int, payload: OrderUpdateStatus, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates the status of a user's order, validating ownership and modifying the database record.
